transcription:
L1 | [redrawn pie chart: Putri salju 12%, Lidah kucing 20%, Sagu keju 8%, Kastengel (right angle), Nastar]
L2 | PS: 12%, LK: 20%, SK: 8% -> 65% [sic]
L3 | KA: 25%
L4 | NA: 35%
L5 | 25%/35% = 100/? => 25 x X = 35 x 100
L6 | 25/100 X = 35/100 x 100
L7 | X = 35 x 4 = 140
L8 | Jumlah Nastar = 140 Toples
reasoning: Kastengel 25% (right angle) and Nastar 35% are found, and the proportion 25% : 100 = 35% : x gives 140 jars, matching the key.
The student computes the cube's surface area 6s^2 = 1350 instead of the inscribed sphere's 4πr^2 with r = 7,5 (706,5 cm^2).
Uses (h^-1 o g^-1 o f^-1) = (f o g o h)^-1 and inverts 2x^2 + 4 to get sqrt((x - 4)/2), matching the key.
The ladder is mis-divided (60 ÷ 2 written as 40) and the student multiplies all divisors (giving 80) rather than only those dividing all three numbers; the FPB is 20.
Identifies 572 as the number between 527 and 752 without 7 in the hundreds place, matching the key.
The model is written correctly, but r = 0,2 is never derived from 14,4 = 10(1 + r)^2; arbitrary values (M0 = 4.400, r = 8) are substituted and the work stops.
δ and ε lie on the same side of the transversal (exterior) and are supplementary (x = 20, δ = 105°, supplement 75°), but the student treats them as equal, giving 125°.

The translation is mis-added (-2 + 5 written as 5 instead of 3), and the 90° rotation is done anticlockwise ((x,y) -> (-y,x)) instead of clockwise ((x,y) -> (y,-x)), giving (-5, 3) instead of (3, -3).
